lines.text: After a nap, I feel good as new.

data.define: Used when something or someone is completely fixed or healthy.

example.text: After a nap, I feel good as new.

misuse.text: Don't call a broken phone 'good as new'.
misuse.why: It means fully repaired or healed.

data.l1_hook: Une sieste, et je suis "good as new".
